digest.component_or_area: GitHub Actions CI/CD workflow and pytest test infrastructure
propositions: Moving macOS pytest temporary trees from runner.temp to an ephemeral APFS RAM disk was hypothesized to reduce Gerrit Verify wall time and runner occupancy by avoiding slow storage for many small Git repository writes.

Measured RAM-disk treatments (runs 31869753711, 31869919362, 31870391571, 31873067707) all exceeded the predeclared 5% improvement threshold (17m26s baseline default, max allowed 16m33.7s) with actual default times of 18m43s, 20m54s, 18m26s, and 20m00s respectively, falsifying the performance hypothesis.

The first treatment exposed that intentionally owner-nonwritable workflow snapshot fixtures in tests/unit/workflow snapshot directories caused PermissionError during recursive basetemp cleanup, requiring explicit permission restoration before removal.

A nested pytest invocation in the cleanup oracle inherited cacheprovider state from the outer full-suite run despite the outer suite disabling cacheprovider, creating a REPO_ROOT leak that was fixed by disabling cacheprovider in the nested process.

The RAM-disk lifecycle and experiment-only workflow contract tests were reverted; both pytest tiers (default and integration) were restored to runner.temp with distinct basetemps maintained, and only snapshot cleanup regression tests and per-test teardown mechanisms were retained.

Merged change 1806 (commit 7d908fbbc6da12f8e274b3ef1e3a2357377799ef) restores the no-RAM production path; selectors, markers, xdist workers, timeouts, Python/platform matrix, coverage behavior, and integration tier remain unchanged.
